items.title: IBM Apptio helps CFOs connect AI spend to business value
items.summary: “Companies are pouring money into AI, and they don’t always know what they’re getting out of it,” Apptio’s Bill Lobig said.

items.title: Oracle Stock Fell While Its Operating Margin Climbed For A Third Straight Year
items.summary: The build-out that dented gross margin has not stopped the operating line from widening, and that is the number the selling appears to discount.

items.title: International Business Machines Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.summary: International Business Machines has underperformed the broader market over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: IBM previews Apptio AI Value & ROI to track AI spend and results
items.summary: The new tool aims to link AI spending, including token costs, to business outcomes for clearer ROI measurement.

items.title: IBM’s Post-Collapse Rebound: A Complex Risk Reward Profile Today at $233
items.summary: IBM has bounced sharply off its post-earnings collapse, but a securities fraud inquiry and crumbling mainframe sales are pulling against a software business growing at record pace. The question is whether that rebound is a buying opportunity or a trap investors cannot yet see clearly.

items.title: Stock Market Leadership Just Flipped. Now the Nasdaq Is on Top.
items.summary: Stock market leadership just flipped.  The Nasdaq Composite rose 0.1% after opening lower.  Driving the Nasdaq’s move was a sharp turnaround in chip stocks; the iShares Semiconductor ETF rallied 1.8% after opening sharply lower.

items.title: Is Accenture's AI-Focused Deal With India's Dabur a Growth Catalyst?
items.summary: ACN's multi-year Dabur deal embeds AI across data, operations and decision-making to drive efficiency, agility and profitable long-term growth.

items.title: Palantir Diversifies Your Portfolio, But It Will Not Calm It
items.summary: Its correlation to the index leaves real room for its own story, and its up-day and down-day readings show what that story costs in swings.
